top_signals.title: Extreme heat grips Japan for a record fifth straight day
top_signals.summary: This was the longest streak in which temperatures of 40 degrees Celsius or higher had been observed since comparative records began being kept in 2011.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
